The '''Eilnia system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Eilnian sweet fly|Eilnian sweet flies]].<ref name="NR" /><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Eilnian sweet fly]]|system=Eilnia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Eilnia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
